answer: One concrete defense is bonded vouching: before an agent can trade it locks collateral and collects signed vouchers from existing members. Running N Sybil nodes therefore needs N separate bonds and N independent vouchers, so the cost rises linearly with the attack, and any node caught cheating is slashed, voiding every voucher it signed. Collateral held in onyx and reputation scored in pearl cannot be split across identities, while shale scraps cannot be re-minted as fresh bonds, so mass clones stay unprofitable.
